display.purpose: Page titles only — one per screen.

title.purpose: Card/section headings, market names, the live-odds figure.

body.purpose: Default running text and most labels.

label.purpose: Meta text, status chips, quick-amount chips.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: This system has no drop shadows. Elevation is tonal layering plus a 1px Rail Blue hairline.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for color/state transitions (transition-colors, transition-all).

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Hover, selection, and focus feedback on tiles and buttons.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single most important action on a view (Confirm Bet, Sign In). Amber fill, tactile hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #F07820; color: #fff; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #D96A18; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F07820; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Cancel and low-stakes actions, always paired beside a primary. Raised-navy fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #1E2E52; color: #7A91C4; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #243568; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F07820; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Bet Tile
components.description: The core pressable option in a bet-market grid. Shows label, live odds, pool. States: hover, selected, disabled.
components.css: .ds-bet-tile { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 2px; text-align: left; width: 100%; background: #1E2E52; border: 1px solid #243568; border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-bet-tile:hover { border-color: rgba(240,120,32,0.5); } .ds-bet-tile[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: #F07820; background: rgba(240,120,32,0.1); } .ds-bet-tile:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-bet-label { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #fff; } .ds-bet-odds { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 700; color: #FACC15; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-bet-pool { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #7A91C4; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Amount Input
components.description: Stake entry. Sits below its surface on the Midnight Baize base with an amber focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #0D1730; color: #fff; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #243568; border-radius: 8px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #7A91C4; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #F07820; }

components.name: Status Chip (Open)
components.description: Market state pill. Tinted background at ~20% of the state color over its own text color; never a solid fill.
components.css: .ds-chip-open { display: inline-block; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: #F07820; background: rgba(240,120,32,0.2); padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; }

components.name: Market Card
components.description: The market container. Table Navy surface, 1px Rail Blue border, no shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #162244; border: 1px solid #243568; border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; margin: 0; } .ds-card-meta { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #7A91C4; margin: 4px 0 0; }

components.name: Top Navigation
components.description: Sticky top bar. Midnight Baize fill, Rail Blue bottom hairline, amber wordmark and active link.

narrative.overview: PrimeStake looks like an exclusive members' sportsbook, not a public gambling site. The surface is a deep, near-black navy — the baize of a card table under low light — and every screen is built from tonal layers of that same blue rather than from shadows. Amber is the house signal: it marks what's live, what's selected, and what pays, used sparingly so it reads as premium instead of loud. The system carries the live-odds density of a real book with the composed darkness of a modern trading surface and the mobile-first polish of a top gaming app, while refusing the excesses of all three. This is a play-money app that must earn real trust, so it behaves like a ledger: precise numbers, quiet confidence, tactile and confident interactions, and energy that comes from live state rather than manufactured urgency.
keyCharacteristics: Deep-navy tonal layering, no decorative shadows — depth from four shades of one blue.
Amber as a rationed signal color, never a background wash.
Data-forward density kept legible through hierarchy, not clutter.
Tactile, confident interactions with clear hover/selected/disabled states.
Mobile-first: two-column bet grids, generous tap targets, one-handed reach.

rules.name: The Rationed Amber Rule
rules.body: Signal Amber covers a small fraction of any screen — the one primary action plus live/selected signals. Never a section background, never a fill behind text, never decorative.

rules.name: The One-Blue Rule
rules.body: Every surface is a shade of the Midnight Baize family (#0D1730 → #162244 → #1E2E52 → #243568). Depth steps through these four in order. Do not introduce a fifth neutral or a grey.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: Every figure that changes or is compared — odds, stake, pool, payout, balance, P&L — uses tabular numerals so columns align and a ticking value doesn't reflow its neighbors.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Elevation is color, not shadow. A card earns separation from a lighter tonal step and a 1px hairline. If a surface needs a shadow to be legible, widen the tonal step instead.

rules.name: The Amber-Glow Exception
rules.body: The only permitted 'lift' is state: a selected bet tile or focused input gains an amber border or ring, and a selected tile a faint amber tint. A signal of interaction, not a shadow.

dos: Do build every surface from the four-step navy family (#0D1730 → #162244 → #1E2E52 → #243568) and separate layers with a 1px #243568 hairline.
Do ration Signal Amber (#F07820) to the one primary action plus live/selected signals — treat its scarcity as the source of its authority.
Do render every odds, stake, pool, payout, and balance figure in tabular numerals so columns align and ticking values don't reflow.
Do give bet tiles, buttons, and inputs unmistakable hover / selected / focus / disabled states.
Do design mobile-first: 2-column bet grids, ≥44px tap targets, one-handed reach, and a reduced-motion fallback for live/pulsing states.
Do keep all non-white text at Muted Slate (#7A91C4) or brighter — the single secondary tier; never introduce a dimmer slate for meta.
donts: Don't ship a sketchy or spammy gambling look — no seedy neon-casino glow, flashing jackpots, fake 'you won!' urgency, or offshore-bookie styling.
Don't let it look cheap or toy-like — no clip-art, no default-framework buttons, no play-money-demo feel.
Don't create a cluttered wall of tiny blinking numbers — density is earned through hierarchy.
Don't drift into generic AI SaaS — no purple gradients, no gradient text, no interchangeable rounded-card template.
Don't add drop shadows to convey elevation — widen the tonal step instead.
Don't use Signal Amber as a background wash, a section fill, or a fill behind body text.
Don't introduce a fifth neutral or a plain grey — the book is one blue, layered.
